run_ner_inference: run a vLLM pooling server and send an HTTP POST request to perform named entity recognition
post_http_request: post an HTTP request to the vLLM pooling API endpoint with a model name and input text
parse_cli_args: parse command line arguments for host, port, and model name for the NER inference script
tokenize_and_predict: tokenize input text and map model predictions to named entity labels using a label map
run_ner_online: run the NER online example script to classify tokens in a sentence using a vLLM pooling server
